title: [Cobblemon] PokeKingdom
description: Build your own Kingdom, unlock powerful perks, and dominate the server while catching, training, and battling with Mega Evolutions in a fully immersive Cobblemon world. Build Your team and compete in our prize pool tournaments.
body:
# 🏰 PokeKingdoms

### 👑  1.7.3 

Build your own Kingdom, rise through the ranks, and dominate — or just chill and catch Pokémon at your own pace.

---

## ⚔️ Core Features

### 🏰 Kingdoms
Create, recruit, upgrade, and compete for the top.

### 🔥 Tournaments
Monthly cash prize battles.

### 🗼 Battle Tower
Endurance-based PvE challenges.

---

## 🌟 Gameplay

- ⚡ Megas & Z-Moves  
- 🏆 Gyms & Elite Four  
- ⚔️ Raids & Bosses  
- 🎯 PokéHunts & Hunt Store  
- 🎁 Daily Rewards  
- 🧬 Breeding & Daycare  
- 🛠️ PokéBuilder  
- 🎒 Backpacks  
- 💪 EV Training  
- 🧸 Custom Skins & Plushies  
- 🌍 GTS & WonderTrade  
- 🏡 Claims & Keep Inventory  

---

## 📅 Events

- ✨ Friday: 5x Shinies  
- 🎉 Saturday: Events  
- 🐉 Sunday: Raids  

---
